description: SEC 10-K government contract dependence — How dependent a US public company is on government customers, read from its latest 10-K: share of revenue from the U.S. Government (largest stated %, with the quote), agencies named (DoD/Department of War, Army, Navy, Air Force, NASA, DHS, CMS...), contract types (fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, T&M, IDIQ, OTA, foreign military sales), procurement rules (FAR, DFARS, CAS, ITAR, CMMC, False Claims Act), risks (termination for convenience, appropriations/shutdown, DCAA audits, debarment, clearances), funded/unfunded backlog quotes, Medicare/Medicaid exposure, and a HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE dependence verdict. Params: ticker (or cik); optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_government_contracts
